title: PostgreSQL Replication Monitor
description: PostgreSQL streaming replication monitoring. Tracks replay lag, replication slot health, WAL accumulation, and conflicts. Requires postgres_exporter (see docs/infra/reviews/review-pg-replication.md).

panels.title: Replay Lag (All Standbys)
panels.description: Replay lag per standby in seconds. WARN > 30s, CRITICAL > 60s.

targets.query:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(now() - write_lag, '$__interval') AS time,
  application_name,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM replay_lag)::float AS replay_lag_seconds
FROM pg_stat_replication
WHERE state = 'streaming'
  AND $__timeFilter(now() - write_lag)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Write/Flush/Replay Lag
panels.description: Detailed lag breakdown for the primary standby. Shows write, flush, and replay lag components.

targets.query:
SELECT
  application_name,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM write_lag)::float AS write_lag_seconds
FROM pg_stat_replication
WHERE state = 'streaming'

SELECT
  application_name,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM flush_lag)::float AS flush_lag_seconds
FROM pg_stat_replication
WHERE state = 'streaming'

SELECT
  application_name,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM replay_lag)::float AS replay_lag_seconds
FROM pg_stat_replication
WHERE state = 'streaming'

panels.title: Standby State
panels.description: Current state of all connected standbys. Non-streaming state needs investigation.

targets.query:
SELECT
  application_name,
  client_addr::text,
  state,
  sync_state,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM replay_lag)::int AS lag_seconds
FROM pg_stat_replication
WHERE state IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Replication Slot Health
panels.description: Replication slot status. Lost/unreserved slots require immediate rebuild.

targets.query:
SELECT
  slot_name,
  slot_type,
  active,
  coalesce(wal_status, 'unknown') AS wal_status,
  pg_size_pretty(pg_wal_lsn_diff(
    pg_current_wal_lsn(),
    coalesce(restart_lsn, pg_current_wal_lsn())
  )::text::bigint) AS retained_wal
FROM pg_replication_slots

panels.title: Total WAL Size
panels.description: Total WAL size on primary disk. Steady growth may indicate a replication slot issue.

targets.query:
SELECT
  now() AS time,
  sum(size) AS wal_bytes
FROM pg_ls_waldir()

panels.title: Replication Conflicts
panels.description: Rate of snapshot conflicts. High rate (>10/sec) indicates vacuum conflicts with standby queries.

targets.query:
SELECT
  datname,
  confl_snapshot AS snapshot_conflicts
FROM pg_stat_database_conflicts
WHERE datname NOT IN ('template0', 'template1')

panels.title: WAL Retention per Slot
panels.description: WAL retained per replication slot. Slots retaining >10GB need investigation.

targets.query:
SELECT
  slot_name,
  pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), coalesce(restart_lsn, pg_current_wal_lsn())) AS retained_bytes
FROM pg_replication_slots
